widgets_values: A photorealistic character expression sheet on a plain light grey studio background, soft even studio lighting, sharp focus, realistic fur detail. The character is a humanoid European red squirrel: a man's body with the head of a real Eurasian red squirrel, russet-orange fur, a cream-white chin and throat, long pointed ear tufts, big glossy dark eyes, long whiskers, a small dark nose and orange front teeth. His furry squirrel neck grows out of his shirt collar. He wears a charcoal grey button-up cardigan over a black t-shirt, blue jeans and brown shoes, and has human hands. Layout: on the left a full-body front view of him standing straight; top middle a large head-and-shoulders side profile facing left; top right a large head-and-shoulders three-quarter view. Bottom row: four large head-and-shoulders portraits of the same squirrel, each with an extreme, overacted emotion like on an animator's expression sheet, but photorealistic. First, laughing hysterically: the head tilted back, the mouth open as wide as possible showing the teeth and the pink tongue, the eyes squeezed shut into happy crescents, the cheeks pushed up, the whiskers spread. Second, sobbing and heartbroken: big shiny tears running down the fur of the cheeks, the wet eyes squinting and pulled down at the outer corners, the mouth open in a loud wail with the corners pulled down, the ear tufts flat back. Third, utterly disgusted: the nose scrunched up hard, the upper lip curled up, one eye squinted shut, the tongue sticking out, the head pulled back and turned away a little. Fourth, furious and screaming: the mouth wide open with the teeth bared, the brows pulled down hard, the eyes narrowed to angry slits, the fur on the head bristling, the ear tufts pinned back. No emotion in the bottom row is mild or neutral; each one is readable from across the room. The same character in every view.
